description: Use this when someone asks for the newest ownership moves across the market: insider purchases or sales, new big or activist stakes, or institutions' reports just filed, optionally for chosen companies. Give it kinds (insider_buys, insider_sells, big_stakes, institutional_reports) and an optional company list. Returns the newest filings (insider trades and big stakes from the last 7 days, institutions' reports from the last 14), newest first, each with company, holder, size in its own currency, dates, the company's 6ix page and the filing.

min_value_usd.description: Insider trades of at least this value in US dollars (trades in other currencies are left out when set)

name: get_latest_ownership_filings
title: Newest ownership filings
